tuning: No tuning: identical defaults to the 1000-evaluation run, including the same SA temperature and per-evaluation cooling rate
selection: All 3 Fisher–Thompson cases plus first 2 Lawrence cases from each size group, with only la36 from the 15x15 group to total 18. Chosen before results.
execution: Four concurrent Python processes, one instance per process; each process runs its algorithms and seeds sequentially
initial_sequential_attempt: Stopped for execution cost before completion; partial data retained locally in results/public-18-10000-sequential-partial and excluded from the final experiment

analysis_plan.within_budget: Repeat Friedman with 99999 within-instance permutations and six two-sided exact Wilcoxon comparisons with Holm correction
analysis_plan.budget_changes: Four paired tests on instance mean RPD changes, with Holm correction across algorithms; report coupled-prefix limitation
analysis_plan.unit: 18 instance means, each averaging seeds 0 through 19
analysis_plan.timing: Analysis plan recorded before completion of the 10000-evaluation results; the 1000-evaluation findings were already known
